author: Vartan Horigian
releaseNotes: TS-3.0.0 (TecnoSimples) — Canais sempre iguais à placa (inclusive teclas físicas e outros controles), rampa ao segurar no dashboard, reconexão robusta e troca de IP automática; boardstatus vira online e é preciso um Save Preferences depois do Update. / Channels always match the board (including wall keys and other controllers), ramp on hold from dashboards, robust reconnection and automatic IP change; boardstatus becomes online, and one Save Preferences is needed after the Update.
